query: My Stellar contract call reads 300 live contract data entries and writes 20. Will one Mainnet transaction fit under the ledger entry limits?
expected_behavior: Names the 400-entry cap on the whole footprint (read-only plus read-write) and checks 320 entries against it
Explains that the 200-entry read limit counts disk reads only (classic entries and archived contract entries being restored), so live contract data does not count toward it
Says the limits are network settings that validators can change, and points to Stellar Lab's Network Limits page or `stellar network settings --network mainnet` for live values
